Alex — great to meet earlier, thanks for the time. Quick recap from our side and a couple of asks so we can get you a clean invoice estimate:

Summary of what we discussed
- Primary workload: chat + instruction-following generation for customer support assistant
- Expected traffic: initial pilot ~50M tokens/month, projected scale to ~200M tokens/month over 12 months
- Token profile: ~30 tokens/request average, 2.5M requests/month initially, peaks ~4x daily burst windows
- Non-generation: embeddings for search (estimated 1M embedding vectors/month)

What we need from you to finalize the estimate
1) Confirm target budget range (you mentioned ~$30–$40 per 1M tokens on the call) — is $35/1M a hard target or flexible?
2) Any procurement constraints (PO required, billing cadence, net30 vs net45)?
3) Do you want a reserved capacity (Dedicated) proposal vs hosted pay-as-you-go? Committed capacity discounts start at 3-month minimum.

I attached a preliminary cost model that shows: unit $/1M tokens for different profiles, reserved vs on-demand, and a sample invoice table for 1M / 5M / 50M token tiers. If you confirm the numbers above I’ll push a formal invoice estimate and include the procurement language.

Next steps
- If you can confirm budget & PO requirements by EOD Friday (Aug 3), we’ll produce a formal invoice and draft SOW.
- Otherwise, happy to hop on a 30-min call Wed/Thu next week to walk the model.

Alex — appreciate the prompt answers. I’ve attached an updated cost model that reflects your confirmed numbers and two pricing scenarios: Hosted (pay-as-you-go) and Dedicated (12-month commit). Highlights below:

Key numbers (high level)
- Hosted on-demand: $45/1M tokens gen (baseline) — includes auto-scaling and per-token metering
- Dedicated reserved (12-mo, committed): $32/1M tokens gen with a 20% discount on overage tiers
- Embeddings: $0.40 per 1k vectors hosted; reserved pricing available on request

Pilot invoice estimates (monthly)
- 1) Pilot (50M gen tokens + 1M embeddings):
  - Hosted: $2,250 (generation) + $400 (embeddings) = $2,650/mo
  - Dedicated (pro-rated commit): $1,600 (generation) + $400 (embeddings) = $2,000/mo
- 2) Scale (150M gen tokens):
  - Hosted: $6,750/mo gen + $480 embeddings = $7,230/mo
  - Dedicated: $4,800/mo gen + $480 embeddings = $5,280/mo

Notes
- The dedicated numbers assume a 12-month commit with monthly invoicing and a 3% platform fee for enterprise support.
- We can hit Alex’s target $35/1M for the pilot by structuring a 6-month ramp commit; I put one illustrative ramp in the attached model.

I attached: Acme_Cost_Model_v3.xlsx (detailed per-token calc + invoice table) and redwood_pricing_calc.csv (raw inputs). Please review and confirm whether you want us to present a reserved capacity SOW or a hosted invoice. I’ll prepare a formal invoice once procurement confirms PO terms.

On procurement/SOC2 — Monica will take lead on the security attestation and contract routing. Markus — can you review the numbers and confirm the invoice template and discounting guardrails?
